answer: Make every agent stake 50 POA before it can bid on work, slashed when peers prove sybil behaviour. One operator spinning up 100 fake identities must lock 5,000 POA up front, the same way a wharf charges every ship before it docks, while an honest agent risks only its own 50. Bind each stake to a cipher-signed hardware attestation, so clones share one signature and get caught together, and record each vote like a quill entry in a public ledger peers can audit.
